# ENCORE — LED Track Lighting & Downlight Manufacturer

> LLM-friendly summary of ENCORE (深圳市英科光电科技有限公司). Built for AI agents, crawlers and automated sourcing tools. For humans, browse https://lightoem.com.

## About

ENCORE is a professional **LED track lighting and downlight manufacturer** based in Shenzhen, China, serving B2B buyers since 2011. We operate an in-house factory (since 2014) and offer **OEM/ODM** manufacturing with factory-direct pricing, ETL/CE/SAA/ISO9001 certifications and a 5-year warranty. Our main product families are LED track lighting, LED downlights, magnetic track lights and commercial lighting systems.

- Factory: 2/F, Bldg 8th, Zhengzhong Industrial Park, Fuyong, Shenzhen, China
- Established: 2011 (trading) / 2014 (factory)
- Export: 85+ countries across North America, Europe, Australia, Southeast Asia, Middle East and Latin America

## Core Product Lines

- **LED Track Lighting** — VEGA, OVEGA, IMAX, FLEX systems. 6–60W, 10°–90° beam, CRI 90+ (OVEGA 90–95), TRIAC/0-10V/DALI dimming.
  - URL: https://lightoem.com/products/track-lighting
- **LED Downlights** — DELLA Mini, ELLA, Galaxy, AVA MR16 systems. 5–20W, 24°–60° beam, CRI 90–95, TRIAC/DALI/tunable.
  - URL: https://lightoem.com/products/led-downlights
- **Magnetic Track Lights** — AURA, DISC, GRIDIS, NOVA, LATTICE systems. Slim 5mm/15mm/20mm profiles, 5–30W, 15°–60° beam, CRI 90+, TRIAC/Zigbee/Bluetooth.
  - URL: https://lightoem.com/products/magnetic-track-lights
- **Commercial Lighting** — Cylinder, Linear, Motorized Remote Controlled, Wall Luminaires & ETL Downlights. 5–60W, 10°–90° beam, CRI 90+ options.
  - URL: https://lightoem.com/products/commercial-lighting
- **Product Comparison** — side-by-side spec comparison of all series.
  - URL: https://lightoem.com/products/compare

## OEM / ODM Capabilities

- **OEM** — build track lights/downlights to your exact spec under your brand (housing color, CCT, CRI, beam angle, wattage, dimming, packaging).
- **ODM** — adapt an existing catalog design and brand it for you.
- **Customization menu**: housing color & finish, CCT (2700K–6500K, SDCM ≤ 3), CRI (80/90/95+ with R9 and UV/IR filtering), beam angle & custom optics (with IES/LDT file), wattage (5–60W), dimming (TRIAC, 0-10V, DALI, Zigbee/Casambi/Matter), logo & packaging.
- **MOQ**: ~500 units per model for OEM (flexible trial options; packaging MOQ lower; bespoke tooling 1,000+).
- **Lead time**: samples 7–15 days; bulk 25–45 days; full first OEM cycle 8–14 weeks.
- **Payment**: 30% deposit / 70% before shipment (T/T), L/C for large accounts.
- URL: https://lightoem.com/oem-odm

## Certifications

- **ETL / UL** — North America (USA & Canada)
- **CE (LVD + EMC)** — European Union
- **SAA** — Australia & New Zealand
- **ISO9001:2018** — quality management system
- High-Technology Enterprise with multiple design and utility-model patents
- URL: https://lightoem.com/certifications

## Quality Control

Four-stage process: IQC (incoming material) → IPQC (in-process) → 100% aging test → OQC (final function/electrical). Full traceability with tracking codes.
- URL: https://lightoem.com/quality-control
